snippet.title: Valdrin - Official Trailer | Medieval Kingdom Builder
snippet.description:
Wishlist Valdrin on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3929800/

Raise a hamlet into a kingdom. Valdrin is a medieval settlement and kingdom sim where every townsman lives a life of their own: they work the fields, trade at market, pray, marry and march to war.

Build through the seasons. Harvests come in, winter buries the roads in snow, and the town grows year after year. Serve the Crown, or declare your independence and pay for it when the Crown's army marches on your walls.

Music: Sofía Domenech

#Valdrin #CityBuilder #PixelArt #IndieGame #ColonySim
